title: Bibliography
subtitle: Curated references from the Active Inference Meta-Analysis project.
audience: Researchers and learners seeking the canonical literature of Active Inference and the Free Energy Principle.
lede: This page presents the curated bibliography from the Active Inference Meta-Analysis project — a computational meta-analysis of the Active Inference and Free Energy Principle literature. The references span foundational FEP papers, Active Inference textbooks, computational methods, knowledge-graph infrastructure, and related work. Each entry includes full bibliographic information and a DOI link to the original publication.

sections.heading: About this bibliography
sections.body: These 71 references are drawn from the manuscript bibliography of the Active Inference Meta-Analysis project (act_inf_metaanalysis). The project employs multi-source literature retrieval from arXiv, Semantic Scholar, and OpenAlex; LLM-based assertion extraction into Nanopublications; probabilistic knowledge graphs; and citation-weighted hypothesis scoring. The full BibTeX source and all project outputs are available on GitHub.

sections.heading: Scope and coverage
sections.body: The bibliography covers foundational work on the Free Energy Principle (Friston 2006, 2010), the Active Inference textbook (Parr, Pezzulo & Friston 2022), methodological advances in discrete and continuous state-space formulations, deep active inference, active inference for robotics and language, and the critical debate around Markov blankets and the FEP's scientific status. It also includes the computational infrastructure references: Nanopublications, knowledge graphs, the Semantic Scholar and OpenAlex platforms, and LLM-based scientific information extraction.
